moments.title: EFL Championship Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new English Football League Championship season begins today, August 14th, with a full weekend of fixtures including Wolves vs Blackburn Rovers to start the campaign.

angles.name: Opening Day Excitement
angles.copy: The whistle blows! The new EFL Championship season kicks off today, August 14th. Who are you backing for promotion this year?

angles.name: Welsh Teams in Action
angles.copy: Our Welsh teams are ready! Swansea City, Cardiff City, and newly promoted Wrexham all begin their Championship campaigns this weekend. Good luck to the lads!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival In Full Swing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, continues to draw huge crowds with thousands of shows across comedy, theatre, music, and more, running until August 31st.

angles.name: Fringe Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing! The Fringe Festival is in full swing, turning the city into a vibrant stage. Who's been up to see a show or two?

angles.name: Scottish Spotlight
angles.copy: From comedy to drama, music to magic – the Edinburgh Fringe is showcasing incredible talent right here in Scotland! What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Top UK Chart
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has claimed the coveted Number 1 spot on the Official UK Singles Chart this week, beating out Shakira and Burna Boy.

angles.name: New Number 1
angles.copy: It's official! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean have soared to Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Big tune, big win!

angles.name: Chart Battle
angles.copy: After a fierce chart battle, Sam Fender & Olivia Dean take the top spot! Were you rooting for 'Rein Me In' or something else this week?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Belinda Carlisle
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, the iconic lead singer of The Go-Go's and a successful solo artist, turns 68 on August 17th.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place On Earth
angles.copy: Get ready to sing along! Belinda Carlisle, the voice behind 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth' and The Go-Go's, turns 68 on Monday. What's your favourite hit?

angles.name: Go-Go's & Solo
angles.copy: From new wave with The Go-Go's to global solo stardom, Belinda Carlisle has done it all. Wishing her a very happy 68th birthday on Monday!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Donnie Wahlberg
moments.blurb: Donnie Wahlberg, member of New Kids on the Block and acclaimed actor, celebrates his 57th birthday on August 17th.

angles.name: Blockhead Birthday
angles.copy: He's still got the right stuff! Happy 57th birthday to New Kids on the Block's Donnie Wahlberg on Monday. Which NKOTB track is your all-time favourite?

angles.name: Music & Movies
angles.copy: From topping the charts with New Kids on the Block to starring in 'Blue Bloods', Donnie Wahlberg turns 57 on Monday. A true multi-talent!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Phoebe Bridgers
moments.blurb: Acclaimed indie-folk singer-songwriter Phoebe Bridgers celebrates her 32nd birthday on August 17th.

angles.name: Indie Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 32nd birthday to the brilliant Phoebe Bridgers on Monday! What's the Phoebe track you can't stop listening to?

moments.title: Happy Birthday The Kid Laroi
moments.blurb: Australian rapper, singer, and songwriter The Kid Laroi, known for hits like 'Stay', turns 23 on August 17th.

angles.name: Young Star Turns 23
angles.copy: From Sydney to global charts, The Kid Laroi celebrates his 23rd birthday on Monday! Drop your favourite Laroi track in the comments!

moments.title: Happy Birthday John Deacon
moments.blurb: John Deacon, the legendary bassist and songwriter for Queen, celebrates his 75th birthday on August 19th.

angles.name: Queen's Bass Master
angles.copy: He gave us 'Another One Bites the Dust' and so much more. Happy 75th birthday to Queen's incredible bassist, John Deacon, on Wednesday!

moments.title: Premier League Season Starts Next Week
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off next Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal taking on Coventry City.

angles.name: PL Is Back!
angles.copy: The countdown is almost over! The Premier League returns next Friday, August 21st. Who's winning the league this season?

angles.name: Opening Weekend
angles.copy: Get ready for the drama! The Premier League season kicks off with Arsenal vs Coventry City next Friday. What game are you most excited for?

moments.title: All Points East Festival Begins
moments.blurb: All Points East Festival returns to London's Victoria Park from August 21-30, featuring headliners like Jorja Smith & Tems, Lorde, Deftones, Tyler, The Creator, and Twenty One Pilots.

angles.name: London's Festival Weekend
angles.copy: East London is about to get loud! All Points East kicks off next Friday with an incredible lineup. Who are you buzzing to see at Victoria Park?

angles.name: Diverse Lineup
angles.copy: From Jorja Smith to Deftones, Lorde to Tyler, The Creator – All Points East brings a massive lineup to London next week! Get ready for a huge weekend.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Next Week
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals take over the UK Bank Holiday weekend from August 27-30, with a huge lineup across rock, pop, hip hop, and dance.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Banger
angles.copy: Who's heading to Reading or Leeds next week? The Bank Holiday weekend is set for an epic soundtrack! What acts are you desperate to catch?

angles.name: Leeds Local Angle
angles.copy: Bramham Park is calling! Leeds Festival kicks off next Thursday, bringing the biggest names in music to Yorkshire. Get ready for a massive Bank Holiday!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: The UK's premier electronic music festival, Creamfields, takes place from August 27-30 in Daresbury, Cheshire, featuring top DJs and live electronic acts.

angles.name: Dance Anthem Mecca
angles.copy: Get your glow sticks ready! Creamfields is just around the corner, bringing the biggest names in dance music to Cheshire for the Bank Holiday weekend. Who's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown to Creamfields is ON! Four days of world-class DJs and electrifying sets begin next Thursday. What's your ultimate festival anthem?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, providing a long weekend to mark the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: That glorious August Bank Holiday weekend is just over two weeks away! What are your plans for the unofficial end of summer? Staycation or getaway?

angles.name: Notting Hill Carnival
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday means one thing for London: Notting Hill Carnival! Get ready for vibrant parades, incredible music, and amazing food.
